content:
The positive gap triples \((a,b,c)\) summing to 8 with each \(<4\) must satisfy \(a,b,c\in\{1,2,3\}\). The only possible multiset is \(\{2,3,3\}\).

So every acute triangle has cyclic gaps \(2,3,3\). Choosing the starting vertex of the unique gap of length \(2\) gives exactly one acute triangle for each of the 8 vertices.

\[
\boxed{8}
\]
